    Some changes and corrections have been made in the Basque language.

notes.title: Difficulty choice: Normal/Easy
notes.content: A new option has been added in the main menu to choose the difficulty level between Normal and Easy. It can be modified at any time by simply accessing the main menu, choosing the desired option and continuing the game.

notes.title: CAR AND PROTAGONIST CONTROLLER IMPROVEMENTS
notes.content: The error in the vertical jump of the main character has been fixed and the driving of the car has been improved with a more realistic behavior.

notes.title: FULL compatibility with Steam Deck!
notes.content:
Now enjoy playing [b]FOBIA ...worse than fear[/b] with [b]Steam Deck[/b] and its [b]full compatibility[/b]. It has its own setup that is loaded by default, you don't have to do anything but play.
Come on!

notes.title: FULL compatibility of the gamepad
notes.content:
The main modification that has been carried out in this update has been the change of gamepad [b]compatibility [/b]from partial to [b]FULL[/b].
Other adjustments have also been made to the gamepad setup so that its handling is as similar to that of a standard controller (change in it´s steering axes), and other modifications in the cinematics menu.

notes.title: Launching this Friday, March 24!
notes.content:
This Friday, March 24, the original adventure of exploration, intrigue and psychological terror [b]Phobia...worse than fear.[/b]" will be released. Don't forget to add it to your wish list and share it with your friends!
  Be the first to reveal their secret!

"[i]There is something worse than fear...[/i]"
